label: Depop
terms_note: Private Partner API: apply by e-mail, sign Depop's API Terms or an Order Form; credentials issued by Depop; rate limits 20 req/s for create/update, 100 req/s otherwise; no diverting users off Depop, no mirroring the UI, no scraping; anti-fraud + data-protection + 'circularity' obligations; sandbox with purchase simulation.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (partner credentials issued by Depop; refresh-token management)
sdks: OpenAPI specification downloadable from the partner docs

auth: 1. Contact Depop's partner team by e-mail; execute the API Terms / Order Form.
2. Receive partner credentials; OAuth with refresh tokens to connect each seller.
3. Use the sandbox (with purchase simulation) before production access.

endpoints.notes: Depop may trim copy / images to its limits

reference.limits: 20 requests per second for create / update operations; 100 requests per second for other features (API Terms). - Access only to approved partner organisations. - No user diversion, no UI mirroring, no scraping or reverse engineering. - Anti-fraud, data-protection and circularity (resale-mission) obligations.
mcp_sdk: SDK: OpenAPI specification downloadable from the partner docs

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Depop Partner API key (issued by Depop to approved enterprise partners; API-key tokens carry every scope); sent as Authorization: Bearer.

adapter.terms: Depop Partner API is for approved enterprise partners (terms at https://partnerapi.depop.com/api-docs/terms/). Products are addressed by your SKU.

me.note: getSellerDetails: {id, username, country_code} of your Depop shop.

update_listing.note: patchProduct PATCH /api/v1/products/by-sku/{sku}/ {price_amount, quantity} changes the LIVE price (a decimal string in the listing's currency) and/or quantity of an ON SALE product; `listing_id` is your SKU. Title/description changes need the full PUT (all product fields) and are not done here.

set_inventory.note: patchProduct {quantity} sets the quantity of an ON SALE product by SKU (`sku` required). Restocking a sold-out product requires the full PUT createOrUpdateProduct, which this tool does not send.

end_listing.note: deleteProduct DELETE /api/v1/products/by-sku/{sku}/ DELETES the listing from Depop; `listing_id` is your SKU.

list_orders.note: getAllOrders ?limit(max 200)&from(ISO date-time): {meta: {cursor, has_more}, data: [{purchase_id, status (SHIPPING_PENDING|SHIPPED|REFUNDED|CANCELLED|COMPLETED), currency, buyer_pays_amount, seller_receives_amount, line_items[{parcel_id...}]}]}. No status filter; pagination is by meta.cursor, so only the first page is returned. Amounts are decimal strings.

not_offered.create_listing: PUT /api/v1/products/by-sku/{sku}/ requires address.country_code, department, product_type, condition, brand_name, attributes, pictures and price_currency besides price and quantity; the vocabulary has no department, product type, condition or brand.
not_offered.mark_shipped: markOrderAsShipped is POST /api/v1/orders/{purchase_id}/parcels/{parcel_id}/mark-as-shipped/ — it needs the parcel_id of the order's line items, which is not a vocabulary input.

evidence: host partnerapi.depop.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://partnerapi.depop.com/api-docs/openapi.yaml: 5/5 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
